thesis: A subscription business should defend trusted workflow and policy rather than sell attention or enclose user memory.
role: Describe economics, competition and staged adjacent markets.

ideas.statement: Customers pay for representation, not overriding preferences; staged computation and bounded dialogue manage costs while success fees risk conflicted agreement.
User-owned trusted memory, contextual outcome learning, policy infrastructure, implementation quality and credible governance form the proposed moat.
Investor collaboration can reuse project evidence; specialist hiring and local services need stronger governance and narrower entry categories.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The mature annual organization-plan example assumes revenue EUR 18,000 and gross contribution EUR 11,000, not observed results.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Platforms, outreach vendors, generic agents, credential providers, marketplaces and brokers each have competitive strengths.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
